poc_plan: POC scope: 4-week lab using a 100k message trace; include steady-state and spike tests.
Week 1: deploy Redwood Dedicated in customer VPC (staging), baseline runs with no caching/quantization.

Week 3: test quantized model variants and compare cost/quality; regen a small eval set for quality regression checks.
Week 4: run production-like spike (3x concurrent), produce final perf/cost deck for procurement and infra sign-off.
